scorecard.name: Active listening
scorecard.coaching: At [09:33], you asked the customer whether she had a Hub 3 or Hub 4 even though she had already stated she had an S-Net Hub 4X at [01:26].

grader.scenario: Intermittent fibre broadband drop-outs every evening; channel congestion and firmware update fixed it
grader.notes: Strong technical troubleshooting call where Daniel diagnoses DFS channel-switching firmware crashes on a Hub 4X, locks clean Wi-Fi channels, and pushes firmware v4.18.2 during a properly managed 95s hold ([07:08]–[09:05]). Drops Active Listening at [09:33] by re-asking which router model Priyanka has after she already told him 'S-Net Hub 4X' at [01:26].

items.name: Branding and Survey Check
items.evidence: Opened with 'thank you for calling S-Net' at [00:00] and closed with 'Thank you for choosing S-Net' at [12:34].

items.name: Hold time and Dead Air
items.evidence: Hard-case PASS: A 95s firmware-update hold before [09:05] was properly announced at [07:08] ('place you on a brief hold') and welcomed back at [09:05] ('Thank you for holding, Priyanka').

items.name: Verified customer
items.evidence: Verified first line of address and four-digit security PIN at [00:59] within the first 240s.

items.name: Personalized the call/ticket appropriately
items.evidence: Used customer name 'Priyanka' naturally throughout the call (e.g., [00:17], [05:33], [09:05]).

items.name: Empathy & Acknowledgment Statement
items.evidence: Hard-case PASS: Concisely validated Priyanka's frustration in a single warm clause at [00:17] ('I completely understand how frustrating it is when your connection drops right in the middle of your evening').

items.name: Paraphrasing
items.evidence: Paraphrased the evening drop-out pattern in his own words and confirmed understanding at [00:38].

items.name: Active listening
items.evidence: Customer stated 'I've got the black S-Net Hub 4X' at [01:26], but Agent asked 'which router model have you got sitting there, is it the Hub 3 or the Hub 4?' at [09:33].

items.name: Took ownership of the problem
items.evidence: Hard-case PASS: Although Agent referenced 'our core network diagnostics team' at [05:16], he explicitly retained full end-to-end ownership at [05:33] ('I'll log the line monitor myself and handle everything from here').

items.name: Build rapport and observed professionalism
items.evidence: Maintained a warm, reassuring, and professional manner throughout the troubleshooting session.

items.name: Probing
items.evidence: Probed into router status lights ([01:34]), ONT optical lights ([01:56]), Ethernet vs Wi-Fi usage ([02:36]), and Wi-Fi icon behavior during drops ([02:56]).

items.name: Confirmed the issue is resolved
items.evidence: After pushing firmware v4.18.2 and locking Wi-Fi channels 1 and 44, confirmed 312 Mbps download and verified with customer at [12:10] and [12:28] that the issue was resolved.
